about:
Shunt Display %1$s
Reads Victron Instant Readout broadcasts. Not affiliated with Victron Energy.
allow_nearby_devices: Allow "Nearby devices" (or Location on older Android) so the app can hear your shunt.
charger_key_help: In VictronConnect: open the charger → ⚙ → ⋮ → Product info → turn on Instant readout via Bluetooth → Show.
chargers_help: Add Victron chargers that send Instant readout (Blue Smart IP22, SmartSolar MPPT, Orion XS) to see their output. Charging that they don’t account for is shown as the other charge source, such as a DC-DC charger.
dashboard_description: State of charge %1$s percent, %2$s, %3$s, status %4$s. Double-tap for settings.
exported: Exported. Copy CONFIG.TXT to the display's SD card and restart it.
full_screen_help: Hides the status and navigation bars on the dashboard. Swipe in from the edge to show them briefly.
imported: Imported. Tap Save to keep these settings.

imported_with_errors.one: Imported, but %1$d line wasn't understood. Tap Save to keep these settings.
imported_with_errors.other: Imported, but %1$d lines weren't understood. Tap Save to keep these settings.

keep_awake_label: Keep the phone awake while open
location_off: Location is off. Older Android versions need it on to scan for Bluetooth devices.
mac_key_help: In VictronConnect: open the SmartShunt → ⚙ → ⋮ → Product info → turn on Instant readout via Bluetooth → Show. Colons and spaces are optional.
nearby_chargers_empty:
Looking for Victron chargers…

Make sure Instant readout via Bluetooth is turned on in VictronConnect.
nearby_empty:
Looking for Victron battery monitors…

Make sure Instant readout via Bluetooth is turned on in VictronConnect.
need_permission: Allow "Nearby devices" to scan for shunts.
pi_about:
Shunt Display for Raspberry Pi %1$s
Reads Victron Instant Readout broadcasts. Not affiliated with Victron Energy.
scanning: Scanning. Tap your shunt to use it.
scanning_chargers: Scanning. Tap your charger to use it.

scanning_others.one: Scanning. Tap your shunt to use it. (%1$d other Victron device isn't a battery monitor.)
scanning_others.other: Scanning. Tap your shunt to use it. (%1$d other Victron devices aren't battery monitors.)

share_help: Exchange settings with the Arduino SmartShunt display's SD card. Export writes a CONFIG.TXT it can read; import reads one from it. Display-only lines, such as its touch calibration, are kept.
